notes.title: Demo Release & Video Tutorial
notes.notes: [p]As of today, the Pixel Frontier: Tactics Demo version is available to play, ahead of the game's participation in Steam Next Fest, starting next week. [/p][p]The Demo features significantly reduced content in comparison to the full version, but should give players a sense of how the game plays, and whether or they will enjoy the full version.[/p][p]For players trying the Pixel Frontier: Tactics Demo, there are a few features worth mentioning to help you learn the basics of what is quite a complex game;[/p][p]Tutorial - There is an in-game tutorial, found in the main menu, which will explain the basics of how combat works and get you started with the game.[/p][p]Tutorial Messages - As you play short tutorial messages will give you more information about various topics of the game, these are designed to give you useful information at a rate that is not overwhelming.[/p][p]The '?' Button - In many in game screens you'll find a '?' button in the bottom left. Hover over this button to display a description of all important elements on screen. This is the best way to figure out what is going on if you don't know what everything on your screen means.[/p][p]Encyclopedia - The game has an in game Encyclopedia, which is ideal if you want to learn more about a specific topic or mechanic. You can also look up specific information about Heroes and Enemies in the Encyclopedia.[/p][p]Video Tutorial - You can find a Video Tutorial below if you prefer, the tutorial is by no means comprehensive, but should give you enough information to get started.[/p][previewyoutube="Fu0XbbRwJmY;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube][p]If you have questions about the game, or run into any bugs/issues, join the discord; [url="https://discord.gg/sDzCYZjP2p"]https://discord.gg/sDzCYZjP2p[/url].[/p]
